prompt: Write a story about John, a successful businessman who falls in love with Kate, the wife of his best friend Tom who is a doctor. He asks his another friend Arthur, an author, to write love letters to Kate for him. Kate falls in love with John and leaves Tom for him. They get married and have a happy life. after a while Arthur reveals that he has cancer and that he also loves Kate. He asks John to tell Kate the truth about the letters. John tells Kate, and she realizes that she loves Arthur too. She leaves John and goes to Arthur. She helps him recover from his cancer, and they get married. John and Tom felt betrayed so they plot against Arthur and Kate. Tom manages to poison and kill Arthur without any suspicion since he had a medical history of cancer. Kate loses everything became bankrupt and alcoholic with no job. Kate must sleep with Tom and John in order to get their support. Kate finds a support group and she writes and publish the story of her life which changes her life forever.
response: John, a successful businessman, falls in love with Kate, the wife of his best friend Tom, a doctor. He enlists the help of his friend Arthur, an author, to write love letters to Kate. Kate falls in love with John and leaves Tom for him. They get married and have a happy life. After a while, Arthur reveals he has cancer and confesses his love for Kate. John, wanting to protect Kate, keeps this information from her. Arthur passes away, and Kate, unaware of his true feelings, continues her life with John. The story ends with Kate writing and publishing her life's story, finding a new sense of purpose.
